state: The methodology VMR0006 v1.1 uses activity method for the demonstration of additionality.
There is no government mandated programme or policy in South Africa ensuring the distribution of new project activity instances or fuel efficient cookstoves.

Where the project activity installs or distributes stoves at zero cost to the end-user and has no other source of revenue other than the sale of GHG credits, the project activity shall be deemed additional.

As per the VMR0006 methodology, the baseline scenario is the continued use of non-renewable wood fuel (firewood) by the target population to meet similar thermal energy needs as provided by project ICS in absence of project activity.

How well do they evidence robust and conservative quantification: Are emission reductions quantified robustly and conservatively? Look for baseline and project emission calculations, leakage, emission factors, uncertainty treatment, conservative choices, and a monitoring plan with QA/QC.

state: Based on the initial number of ICS planned for PI1-K2C and taking the expected 5-year operational lifetime of the ICS into account, the GP’s ex-ante ERs were modelled to represent a conservative approximation.

The sample size and selection were determined in accordance with the CDM guidance on “Sampling and surveys for CDM project activities and programmes of activities v04.0” with a 90/10 confidence/precision level.
Leakage shall be considered as default 0.95 in accordance with Section 8.3 of the applied methodology VRM0006 v1.

Data from the monitoring survey will be collected at least biennially and applied to the emissions reductions calculations during that monitoring period. Where the required level of precision is not met either additional surveys may be completed, or the lower bound value applied.

state: The project proponent shall conduct a local stakeholder consultation prior to validation as a way to inform the design of the project and maximize participation from stakeholders. Such consultations allow stakeholders to evaluate impacts, raise concerns about potential negative impacts and provide input on the project design.
No natural and human-induced risks to local stakeholder well-being is expected arising from the project implementation during the project lifecycle.

A grievance redress mechanism will be developed specifically for each Project Instance and included in the project design documents. Each IP will define a grievance mechanism that is most appropriate to their operations and to the communities within the project boundary.
- Reduce wood cutting which leads to deforestation and loss of biodiversity. Promote sustainable ecosystems and ecological balance.
